trickyParts: The address bucket is given back too, not only the account bucket the tester's test names: with the daemon retrying every 10 s, the address bucket (burst 10, two a minute) drains after about two and a half minutes of a database outage, and its 429 then sends the daemon to its long schedule. Both are given back only on a 5xx after the bucket was spent; a 4xx spends both, as the architect's constraint requires.
TakeAt checks the bucket before reserving and the give-back cancels the reservation at the time of the take, since rate.Reservation.CancelAt restores nothing when called after the reservation's time.
